newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan offers 12 million dinars T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Jordan offers 12 million dinars T-bonds.

text.p: Jordan's Central Bank announced on Monday it was offering investors 12 million dinars of Treasury bonds in a competitive auction for the first time.

The Central Bank said the five-year T-bonds, the first to be issued this year, had closing date for subscription on Tuesday July 8. They would be carry a variable annual yield to be paid in half-yearly installments.
The last seven year T-bond was issued last September with a fixed 9.25 percent yield.
The bonds, sold in blocs of 1,000 dinars each, are traded instruments with their gains exempt from tax.
